name: mailbride-mcp
description: Secure local MailBride MCP tools for multiple IMAP and SMTP accounts in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search, read, draft, reply, forward, and organize email.
interface.longDescription: Connect multiple IMAP and SMTP accounts locally so Codex can search mail and contacts, read threads and attachments, compose with To, CC, and BCC, reply, reply-all, forward, and manage messages with explicit safety controls.
defaultPrompt: Search all my mailboxes for recent messages about a topic.
Find a contact and draft a reply for my approval.
Summarize an email thread and show unanswered messages.
